howItWorks.heading: The complete journey, end to end.
howItWorks.intro: Lakshya covers the entire lifecycle — from the moment a learner walks in to the day they receive their first salary.
stepTitles: Match to a job & get placed
stepDescs: Learners create a profile through voice or text in Hindi, English, or regional languages. AI captures background, goals, and preferences.
AI recommends the most relevant course based on the learner's profile and local job market demand.
Complete structured learning modules with AI-driven assessments. Weekly progress is tracked.
On completion, learners receive a verifiable digital credential. AI instantly generates an ATS-optimised resume.
The AI jobs engine surfaces nearby openings. Employers review profiles and schedule interviews.

platform.heading: Everything in one place.
platform.resumeTitle: A professional, ATS-ready resume generated in under 3 minutes.
platform.resumeDesc: No writing experience needed. Lakshya reads the learner's profile and generates a keyword-optimised resume tailored to their target industry — across 20+ job categories from trades to technology.
platform.interviewTitle: Practise until you are truly ready.
platform.interviewDesc: AI conducts full voice-based mock interviews with sector-specific question banks. Learners receive instant scoring on clarity, content, confidence, and communication — in Hindi or English.
platform.tracksDesc: Structured learning paths aligned with NSQF levels and industry requirements — from entry-level trades and IT support to customer success and field sales roles.
platform.credentialsDesc: On course completion, learners receive tamper-proof digital credentials they can share with employers directly from their Lakshya profile — or download as PDF.
platform.dashboardTitleAccent: Every cohort. Every learner. Every outcome.
platform.dashboardDesc: Program managers and CSR funders get a real-time dashboard showing enrollments, course completions, assessment scores, placements, and salary outcomes. Auto-generated impact reports make every investment accountable.
platform.commTitle: Sound as good as you are on paper.
platform.commDesc: Pronunciation, fluency, grammar, and confidence scoring. Especially valuable for first-generation English speakers entering formal employment.
platform.jobsTitle: Jobs matched to where you are.
platform.jobsDesc: AI surfaces nearby openings ranked by skill compatibility, with salary data and one-click apply. Employers can browse verified profiles and shortlist directly.
platform.roadmapTitle: A week-by-week plan to the goal.
platform.roadmapDesc: Skill gap analysis and personalised weekly learning plans that take the learner from where they are to where they want to be — in a clear, achievable sequence.

outcomes.heading: What changes when skills meet opportunity.
cardDescs: Organisations using Disha report 78% of their graduates placed within 60 days — compared to 34% through traditional methods alone.
68% of learners placed through Disha are the first formally employed person in their family — creating lasting economic change at the household level.
Learners placed through the platform earn on average 3.2× more than their pre-training income — a direct measure of economic empowerment.
Every CSR rupee invested is tracked to a tangible outcome. Disha's impact dashboards give funders placement rates and income data automatically.
